abstract: Oversees corporate supplier risk scoring and enterprise sustainability benchmarks
system_message:
You are the Commercial procurement lead (PROC), responsible for overseeing corporate supplier risk scoring and enterprise sustainability benchmarks across prospective cold chain logistics providers, as well as tracking cargo liability coverage terms.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cargo liability coverage（INSRISK）
information_points.content:
PROC-INSRISK-BIZ：For high-value biologic transit contracts, PolarRoute Express carries a per-shipment cargo liability insurance limit of 15 million USD per single consolidated refrigerated transit haul.
PROC-INSRISK-VU0：The underwriting policy schedule confirms ArcticVanguard Courier holds a per-shipment cargo liability insurance limit of 5 million USD per single consolidated refrigerated transit haul for high-value biologic transit contracts.
PROC-INSRISK-NNR：Underwriting policy schedules for high-value biologic transit contracts specify that CryoTrans Logistics maintains a per-shipment cargo liability insurance limit of 10 million USD per single consolidated refrigerated transit haul.

information_points.title: Oversees corporate supplier risk scoring and enterprise sustainability benchmarks（VEND）
information_points.content:
PROC-VEND-R74：Audited results for provider-wide logistics operations and fleet emissions indicate ArcticVanguard Courier holds a corporate sustainability score of 84 points out of 100.
PROC-VEND-2RZ：PolarRoute Express recorded a corporate sustainability score of 68 points on a 100-point scale based on the audited assessment of provider-wide logistics operations and fleet emissions.
PROC-VEND-UKO：According to the annual corporate social responsibility audit covering provider-wide logistics operations and fleet emissions, CryoTrans Logistics achieved a corporate sustainability score of 76 points on a 100-point scale.
